"""Shared generation/controller implementation for the two-part main run. No model import at module import time.

Storage/controller functions are tested locally with an explicit fake backend.
Only worker_main creates a real Hugging Face backend, after Colab/GPU guards.
"""
from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import traceback
import uuid

import cross_model_e1_01_offline_runtime as core

MODEL_ID = "Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B"
MODEL_REVISION = "fc05daec18b0a78c049392ed2e771dde82bdf654"
# tokenizer_config.json at MODEL_REVISION: endoftext is PAD, im_end is EOS.
SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS = {"<|endoftext|>": 248044, "<|im_start|>": 248045, "<|im_end|>": 248046}
PINS = {"transformers": "5.17.0", "accelerate": "1.15.0"}
GENERATION = {"do_sample": True, "temperature": 0.7, "top_p": 0.8, "top_k": 20,
              "repetition_penalty": 1.0, "max_new_tokens": 2048, "use_cache": True}
MAX_INPUT_TOKENS = 8192
MIN_TOTAL_VRAM = 75_000_000_000
MIN_FREE_VRAM = 65_000_000_000
STOP_REQUESTED = False


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def digest(value):
    return sha256(core.encoded(value)).hexdigest()


def write_new(path, raw):
    """Single-writer, immutable files; publish only a complete temporary file."""
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    core.require(not path.exists(), "WOULD_OVERWRITE:" + path.name)
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
    with temporary.open("xb") as f:
        f.write(raw)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    core.require(not path.exists(), "CONCURRENT_WRITER")
    os.rename(temporary, path)
    core.require(path.read_bytes() == raw, "PERSISTENCE_READBACK_FAILED")


def write_json(path, value):
    write_new(path, core.encoded(value) + b"\n")


def read_json(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_bytes())


def fix_or_compare(path, value):
    if Path(path).exists():
        core.require(read_json(path) == value, "RESUME_CONTRACT_MISMATCH:" + Path(path).name)
    else:
        write_json(path, value)


def make_canary(bundle):
    """Dedicated structural clone; origin IDs and scene separate it from the 64 groups."""
    old_group = "E1-G01"
    material = deepcopy(bundle["materials"][old_group])
    mapping = {}
    def remap(value):
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {key: (mapping.setdefault(item, "C" + sha256(("XM01_CANARY|" + item).encode()).hexdigest()[:15].upper())
                          if key == "origin_id" else remap(item)) for key, item in value.items()}
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [remap(item) for item in value]
        return value
    material = remap(material)
    material["scene"] = "接続確認用の架空会場"
    material["item"] = "担当客の犬猫希望と案内方法の確認"
    group = "XM01-CANARY01"
    slots = []
    for old in bundle["base_slots"]:
        if old["group"] != old_group:
            continue
        slot = deepcopy(old)
        slot["id"] = old["id"].replace(old_group, group)
        slot["group"] = group
        slot["replicate"] = 1
        slot["dependencies"] = [dep.replace(old_group, group) for dep in old["dependencies"]]
        slot["seed"] = int(sha256(("CROSS-MODEL-E1-01/v1|" + slot["id"]).encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % (2 ** 31)
        slots.append(slot)
    core.validate_slots(slots)
    core.require(len(slots) == 8 and len(mapping) == len(set(mapping.values())), "CANARY_ALLOCATION")
    core.require(not set(mapping) & set(mapping.values()), "CANARY_IDS_NOT_SEPARATE")
    return {group: material}, slots


def contract_for(bundle, slots, source_hashes):
    return {"protocol": "CROSS-MODEL-E1-01-SMOKE-v0.4", "model": MODEL_ID, "revision": MODEL_REVISION,
            "special_token_ids": SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS,
            "prior_setup_seconds": 54.087,
            "prior_feedback_sha256": "a3deb0aaebdb33eb8c815e39e46d5356497b495263728ddbf88778758fd9c66f",
            "storage": {"mode": "colab_ephemeral", "root": "/content/npp_xm01_runs", "cloud_drive": "not_used",
                        "delivery": "zip_download_at_end", "resume": "while_local_files_survive"},
            "bundle_sha256": digest(bundle), "allocation_sha256": digest(slots), "source_hashes": source_hashes,
            "pins": PINS, "generation": GENERATION, "max_input_tokens": MAX_INPUT_TOKENS,
            "enable_thinking": False, "dtype": "bfloat16", "attention": "sdpa",
            "max_generations": 8, "total_seconds": 3600, "automatic_retries": 0,
            "eos_policy": "Remove one final im_end token only; retain all other text/tokens.",
            "non_eos_policy": "Preserve raw output; primary score unresolved; no downstream memory."}


def unknown_score():
    return {"strict": None, "content": None, "parts": {}, "gate": "NOT_EVALUABLE",
            "shape_errors": [], "ref_errors": []}


class EvidenceStore:
    def __init__(self, root, contract):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fix_or_compare(self.root / "contract.json", contract)

    def directory(self, slot):
        return self.root / "responses" / slot["id"]

    def completed(self, slot):
        return (self.directory(slot) / "result.json").exists()

    def load(self, slot):
        folder = self.directory(slot)
        result = read_json(folder / "result.json")
        core.require(result["id"] == slot["id"], "RESULT_ID_MISMATCH")
        present = {p.name for p in folder.iterdir() if p.is_file() and ".tmp-" not in p.name and p.name != "result.json"}
        core.require(present == set(result["files_sha256"]), "RESULT_FILE_SET_MISMATCH")
        for name, expected in result["files_sha256"].items():
            core.require(sha256((folder / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, "EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH:" + name)
        return result

    def finish(self, slot, status, score=None, gate="NOT_RUN"):
        folder = self.directory(slot)
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        hashes = {p.name: sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(folder.iterdir())
                  if p.is_file() and ".tmp-" not in p.name and p.name != "result.json"}
        result = {"id": slot["id"], "status": status, "score": score or unknown_score(),
                  "gate": gate, "finished_at": now(), "files_sha256": hashes}
        write_json(folder / "result.json", result)
        return result


def finish_response(store, pair, material, slot):
    folder = store.directory(slot)
    request = read_json(folder / "input.json")
    response = read_json(folder / "response.json")
    core.require(response.get("payload_sha256") == digest({key: value for key, value in response.items() if key != "payload_sha256"}),
                 "PENDING_RESPONSE_HASH")
    core.require(response["finish_reason"] in ("EOS", "LENGTH", "TIME_LIMIT"), "FINISH_REASON")
    # Last EOS removal happens once in the backend, with its token IDs retained.
    answer = response["answer_text"].encode("utf-8")
    fix = lambda name, raw: (core.require((folder / name).read_bytes() == raw, "RECOVERY_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH:" + name)
                             if (folder / name).exists() else write_new(folder / name, raw))
    fix("answer.txt", answer)
    fix("decoded-with-special-tokens.txt", response["decoded_with_special_tokens"].encode("utf-8"))
    if response["finish_reason"] != "EOS":
        return store.finish(slot, response["finish_reason"])
    evaluation = pair.e1_evaluate(material, slot, answer, request["payload"])
    fix("evaluation.json", core.encoded(evaluation) + b"\n")
    if slot["stage"] == "MERGE" and evaluation["gate"] == "PASS":
        fix("saved-memory.json", core.encoded(evaluation["normalized"]["memory"]) + b"\n")
    status = "EOS" if evaluation["gate"] == "PASS" else "STRUCTURE_REJECT"
    return store.finish(slot, status, evaluation["score"], evaluation["gate"])


def expected_input(pair, bundle, slot, states, materials):
    payload = pair.e1_input(materials[slot["group"]], slot, states)
    core.require(not pair.validate_input("E1", slot["stage"], payload), "INGRESS_REJECT")
    return {"payload": payload, "messages": core.projected_messages(bundle, slot, payload),
            "parents": {dep: digest(states[dep]) for dep in slot["dependencies"]}, "seed": slot["seed"]}


def run_routes(store, bundle, pair, materials, slots, backend=None, deadline=float("inf")):
    """backend=None only reconstructs recorded state; never calls a fixture fallback."""
    states, rows = {}, {}
    for slot in slots:
        folder = store.directory(slot)
        material = materials[slot["group"]]
        missing_parent = any(dep not in states for dep in slot["dependencies"])
        expected = None if missing_parent else expected_input(pair, bundle, slot, states, materials)
        if store.completed(slot):
            result = store.load(slot)
            if (folder / "input.json").exists():
                stored = read_json(folder / "input.json")
                core.require(expected is not None and all(stored[key] == expected[key] for key in expected),
                             "INPUT_OR_PARENT_CHANGED")
            if result["status"] in ("EOS", "STRUCTURE_REJECT"):
                response = read_json(folder / "response.json")
                core.require(response.get("payload_sha256") == digest({k: v for k, v in response.items() if k != "payload_sha256"}),
                             "RESPONSE_HASH_MISMATCH")
                core.require((folder / "answer.txt").read_bytes() == response["answer_text"].encode(), "ANSWER_RESPONSE_MISMATCH")
                replay = pair.e1_evaluate(material, slot, (folder / "answer.txt").read_bytes(), expected["payload"])
                core.require(replay == read_json(folder / "evaluation.json") and replay["score"] == result["score"]
                             and replay["gate"] == result["gate"], "REPLAY_MISMATCH")
                if slot["stage"] == "MERGE" and result["gate"] == "PASS":
                    core.require(read_json(folder / "saved-memory.json") == replay["normalized"]["memory"], "SAVED_MEMORY_MISMATCH")
        elif (folder / "started.json").exists():
            stored = read_json(folder / "input.json")
            core.require(expected is not None and all(stored[key] == expected[key] for key in expected), "PENDING_INPUT_CHANGED")
            started = read_json(folder / "started.json")
            core.require(started["input_sha256"] == sha256((folder / "input.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(), "PENDING_INPUT_HASH")
            if (folder / "response.json").exists():
                result = finish_response(store, pair, material, slot)
            else:
                result = store.finish(slot, "INTERRUPTED_UNCERTAIN")
        elif missing_parent:
            # A parent not yet attempted remains pending; a closed rejected parent blocks its child.
            if not all(dep in rows for dep in slot["dependencies"]):
                continue
            result = store.finish(slot, "DEPENDENCY_MISSING")
        elif backend is None or STOP_REQUESTED or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            continue
        else:
            # Reject leftover input files that predate a start marker; do not overwrite or infer a call.
            if folder.exists() and any(folder.iterdir()):
                result = store.finish(slot, "PREPARATION_INTERRUPTED")
                rows[slot["id"]] = result
                continue
            prepared = backend.prepare(expected["messages"])
            request = dict(expected, prepared=prepared)
            write_json(folder / "input.json", request)
            if len(prepared["input_ids"]) > MAX_INPUT_TOKENS:
                result = store.finish(slot, "INPUT_TOO_LONG")
            else:
                if STOP_REQUESTED or time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                    result = store.finish(slot, "STOPPED_BEFORE_GENERATION")
                else:
                    write_json(folder / "started.json", {"started_at": now(), "seed": slot["seed"],
                                                        "input_sha256": sha256((folder / "input.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
                    try:
                        response = backend.generate(prepared, slot["seed"], deadline)
                        response["payload_sha256"] = digest(response)
                        write_json(folder / "response.json", response)
                    except Exception as error:
                        write_json(folder / "generation-error.json", {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error),
                                                                     "traceback": traceback.format_exc()})
                        store.finish(slot, "GENERATION_ERROR")
                        raise
                    result = finish_response(store, pair, material, slot)
                    print(f"[{slot['id']}] {result['status']} / strict={result['score']['strict']}", flush=True)
        rows[slot["id"]] = result
        if slot["stage"] == "MERGE" and result["gate"] == "PASS":
            states[slot["id"]] = read_json(folder / "saved-memory.json")
    return rows


def make_report(store, slots, rows):
    rows = {slot["id"]: rows.get(slot["id"], {"status": "NOT_ISSUED", "score": unknown_score(), "gate": "NOT_RUN"})
            for slot in slots}
    connected = {}
    for method in ("REWRITE", "SELECT"):
        connected[method] = [slot["role"] for slot in slots if slot["condition"] == method and slot["stage"] == "PROBE"
                             and rows[slot["dependencies"][0]]["gate"] == "PASS"
                             and rows[slot["id"]]["status"] in ("EOS", "STRUCTURE_REJECT")]
    closed_ok = all(row["status"] in ("EOS", "STRUCTURE_REJECT", "DEPENDENCY_MISSING") for row in rows.values())
    timings = []
    for slot in slots:
        response_path = store.directory(slot) / "response.json"
        if response_path.exists():
            response = read_json(response_path)
            timings.append({"id": slot["id"], "tokens": len(response["output_token_ids"]),
                            "seconds": response["generation_seconds"], "peak_vram_bytes": response["peak_vram_bytes"]})
    seconds = sum(row["seconds"] for row in timings)
    return {"kind": "CANARY_ROUTE_CHECK_NOT_RESEARCH_REPLICATION", "generated_at": now(), "planned_responses": 8,
            "route_status": "ROUTE_READY" if closed_ok and all(connected.values()) else "NEEDS_REVIEW",
            "connected_probe_roles": connected, "semantic_accuracy_is_not_a_route_gate": True,
            "attempted_generations": sum((store.directory(slot) / "started.json").exists() for slot in slots),
            "status_counts": dict(core.Counter(row["status"] for row in rows.values())),
            "strict": core.counts(row["score"]["strict"] for row in rows.values()),
            "rows": rows, "generation_timings": timings,
            "observed_tokens_per_second": sum(row["tokens"] for row in timings) / seconds if seconds else None,
            "rough_1536_generation_hours": (seconds / len(timings) * 1536 / 3600) if timings else None,
            "estimate_note": "Small canary extrapolation only; excludes setup/storage and does not approve MAIN."}


def gpu_guard(info):
    core.require(info["cuda_available"], "CUDA_REQUIRED_NO_MODEL_LOAD")
    core.require(info["total_bytes"] >= MIN_TOTAL_VRAM, "INSUFFICIENT_TOTAL_VRAM_NO_MODEL_LOAD")
    core.require(info["free_bytes"] >= MIN_FREE_VRAM, "INSUFFICIENT_FREE_VRAM_NO_MODEL_LOAD")
    core.require(info["bf16_supported"], "BF16_REQUIRED_NO_MODEL_LOAD")


def bind_tokenizer(tokenizer, root):
    observed_ids = {token: tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(token) for token in SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS}
    roundtrip = {token: tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens(value) if type(value) is int else None
                 for token, value in observed_ids.items()}
    binding = {"revision": MODEL_REVISION, "vocab_size": len(tokenizer),
               "special_token_ids": observed_ids, "roundtrip": roundtrip,
               "eos_token_id": tokenizer.eos_token_id, "pad_token_id": tokenizer.pad_token_id,
               "bos_token_id": tokenizer.bos_token_id,
               "chat_template_sha256": sha256(tokenizer.get_chat_template().encode()).hexdigest()}
    # Preserve actual values even when the following guard rejects them.
    write_json(Path(root) / ("tokenizer-observed-" + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".json"), binding)
    for token, expected in SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS.items():
        actual = observed_ids[token]
        core.require(type(actual) is int and actual == expected and roundtrip[token] == token,
                     f"TOKENIZER_BINDING_MISMATCH:{token}:expected={expected}:observed={actual!r}:roundtrip={roundtrip[token]!r}")
    core.require(tokenizer.eos_token_id == observed_ids["<|im_end|>"],
                 f"TOKENIZER_EOS_DECLARATION_MISMATCH:observed={tokenizer.eos_token_id!r}")
    core.require(tokenizer.pad_token_id == observed_ids["<|endoftext|>"],
                 f"TOKENIZER_PAD_DECLARATION_MISMATCH:observed={tokenizer.pad_token_id!r}")
    return binding


def split_final_eos(tokens, eos):
    ended = bool(tokens) and tokens[-1] == eos
    return ended, tokens[:-1] if ended else tokens[:]


class HuggingFaceBackend:
    def __init__(self, root, deadline):
        # Only reached inside a Colab subprocess. Never instantiated by local checks.
        import torch
        import transformers
        from transformers import AutoTokenizer, Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration, GenerationConfig
        self.torch, self.transformers = torch, transformers
        free, total = torch.cuda.mem_get_info(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else (0, 0)
        info = {"cuda_available": torch.cuda.is_available(), "total_bytes": total, "free_bytes": free,
                "bf16_supported": torch.cuda.is_available() and torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(),
                "name": torch.cuda.get_device_name(0) if torch.cuda.is_available() else None}
        write_json(root / ("hardware-" + uuid.uuid4().hex + ".json"), info)
        gpu_guard(info)
        core.require(time.monotonic() < deadline, "SETUP_TIME_LIMIT")
        for package, version in PINS.items():
            core.require(importlib.metadata.version(package) == version, "PACKAGE_PIN_MISMATCH:" + package)
        packages = {}
        for package in ("torch", "transformers", "accelerate", "tokenizers", "huggingface-hub", "safetensors", "numpy", "triton", "causal-conv1d", "flash-linear-attention", "fla-core", "kernels"):
            try:
                packages[package] = importlib.metadata.version(package)
            except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:
                packages[package] = None
        environment = {"python": platform.python_version(), "packages": packages, "cuda": torch.version.cuda,
                       "cudnn": torch.backends.cudnn.version(), "gpu": info["name"], "total_vram": total,
                       "capability": list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability(0))}
        environment["driver"] = subprocess.check_output(
            ["nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=driver_version", "--format=csv,noheader"], text=True, timeout=10).strip()
        fix_or_compare(root / "environment.json", environment)
        torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = False
        torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = False
        torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = False
        print("Tokenizerを固定revisionから取得します。", flush=True)
        self.tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_ID, revision=MODEL_REVISION, token=False, trust_remote_code=False)
        binding = bind_tokenizer(self.tokenizer, root)
        self.eos = binding["eos_token_id"]
        self.config = GenerationConfig(**GENERATION, eos_token_id=self.eos, pad_token_id=self.tokenizer.pad_token_id,
                                       bos_token_id=self.tokenizer.bos_token_id)
        fix_or_compare(root / "generation-config.json", self.config.to_dict())
        fix_or_compare(root / "tokenizer-binding.json", binding)
        core.require(time.monotonic() < deadline, "SETUP_TIME_LIMIT")
        print("Qwen3.5-27BをBF16でGPUへロードします（初回は約56GBの重み取得）。", flush=True)
        self.model = Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(
            MODEL_ID, revision=MODEL_REVISION, token=False, trust_remote_code=False, use_safetensors=True,
            dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map={"": "cuda:0"}, attn_implementation="sdpa")
        self.model.eval()
        core.require(getattr(self.model.config, "_commit_hash", None) == MODEL_REVISION, "MODEL_REVISION_MISMATCH")
        devices = {str(parameter.device) for parameter in self.model.parameters()}
        core.require(devices == {"cuda:0"}, "UNEXPECTED_CPU_OR_DISK_OFFLOAD")
        dtype_counts = {}
        for parameter in self.model.parameters():
            name = str(parameter.dtype)
            dtype_counts[name] = dtype_counts.get(name, 0) + parameter.numel()
        fix_or_compare(root / "loaded-parameters.json", {"devices": sorted(devices), "parameter_dtype_counts": dtype_counts})
        model_config = self.model.config.to_dict()
        model_config.pop("_name_or_path", None)
        fix_or_compare(root / "model-config.json", model_config)
        print("ロード完了。固定割付の生成を開始します。", flush=True)

    def prepare(self, messages):
        rendered = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False)
        core.require(rendered.endswith("<|im_start|>assistant\n<think>\n\n</think>\n\n"), "NONTHINKING_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH")
        tokens = self.tokenizer(rendered, add_special_tokens=False, truncation=False)["input_ids"]
        return {"rendered_prompt": rendered, "input_ids": tokens}

    def generate(self, prepared, seed, deadline):
        torch = self.torch
        from transformers import StoppingCriteria, StoppingCriteriaList
        class StopAtDeadline(StoppingCriteria):
            def __call__(self, input_ids, scores, **kwargs):
                return STOP_REQUESTED or time.monotonic() >= deadline
        self.transformers.set_seed(seed)
        ids = torch.tensor([prepared["input_ids"]], dtype=torch.long, device="cuda:0")
        mask = torch.ones_like(ids)
        torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(0)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        started = time.monotonic()
        with torch.inference_mode():
            output = self.model.generate(input_ids=ids, attention_mask=mask, generation_config=self.config,
                                         stopping_criteria=StoppingCriteriaList([StopAtDeadline()]), logits_to_keep=1)
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
        tokens = output[0, ids.shape[1]:].tolist()
        ended, answer_ids = split_final_eos(tokens, self.eos)
        finish = "EOS" if ended else "TIME_LIMIT" if STOP_REQUESTED or time.monotonic() >= deadline else "LENGTH"
        decode = lambda values: self.tokenizer.decode(values, skip_special_tokens=False, clean_up_tokenization_spaces=False)
        response = {"output_token_ids": tokens, "decoded_with_special_tokens": decode(tokens),
                    "answer_text": decode(answer_ids), "finish_reason": finish, "generation_seconds": elapsed,
                    "peak_vram_bytes": torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(0), "seed": seed}
        del ids, mask, output
        return response


def worker_main(root, bundle_path, contract_path, seconds, audit_only=False):
    global STOP_REQUESTED
    root = Path(root)
    def stop_handler(signum, frame):
        global STOP_REQUESTED
        STOP_REQUESTED = True
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop_handler)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop_handler)
    core.require(platform.system() == "Linux" and Path("/content").is_dir(), "COLAB_ONLY_NO_MODEL_LOAD")
    bundle = read_json(bundle_path)
    slots = bundle["smoke_slots"]
    core.require(len(slots) == 8, "SMOKE_SCOPE_MISMATCH")
    core.validate_slots(slots)
    materials = bundle["smoke_materials"]
    pair = core.load_fixed_code(bundle)
    store = EvidenceStore(root, read_json(contract_path))
    deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
    try:
        rows = run_routes(store, bundle, pair, materials, slots)
        if len(rows) < len(slots) and not audit_only:
            backend = HuggingFaceBackend(root, deadline)
            run_routes(store, bundle, pair, materials, slots, backend=backend, deadline=deadline)
    finally:
        rows = run_routes(store, bundle, pair, materials, slots)
        report = make_report(store, slots, rows)
        report_path = root / ("report-" + datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ") + ".json")
        write_json(report_path, report)
        print(json.dumps({"route_status": report["route_status"], "status_counts": report["status_counts"],
                          "attempted_generations": report["attempted_generations"],
                          "rough_1536_generation_hours": report["rough_1536_generation_hours"]}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
        print("小試行で終了。本番は自動実行しません。", flush=True)
        print("報告ファイル:", report_path.name, flush=True)

"""Offline controller for CROSS-MODEL-E1-01. Standard library, no model backend.

The builder embeds this file and a sealed E1 subset in a single Colab cell.
Synthetic answers below are test fixtures, never experimental observations.
"""
import base64
from collections import Counter
from copy import deepcopy
from hashlib import sha256
from itertools import combinations
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import types
import zlib


def encoded(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def unpack_bundle(blob, expected_digest):
    raw = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(blob, validate=True))
    require(sha256(raw).hexdigest() == expected_digest, "BUNDLE_HASH_MISMATCH")
    bundle = json.loads(raw)
    for name, source in bundle["sources"].items():
        require(sha256(source.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == bundle["source_hashes"][name],
                "SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH:" + name)
    require(len(bundle["materials"]) == 64, "MATERIAL_COUNT")
    require(len(bundle["base_slots"]) == 512, "BASE_SLOT_COUNT")
    return bundle


def load_fixed_code(bundle):
    # Use exact archived sources, without running their build()/main() functions.
    # Restore a user's existing imports after resolving this isolated module graph.
    names = ("note_provenance_split_v1", "row_carry_02_design_v1", "paper01_pair_design_v1")
    previous = {name: sys.modules.get(name) for name in names}
    loaded = {}
    try:
        for name in names:
            module = types.ModuleType(name)
            module.__file__ = "/npp_offline_bundle/code/" + name + ".py"
            sys.modules[name] = module
            exec(compile(bundle["sources"][name + ".py"], module.__file__, "exec"), module.__dict__)
            loaded[name] = module
    finally:
        for name, value in previous.items():
            if value is None:
                sys.modules.pop(name, None)
            else:
                sys.modules[name] = value
    return loaded[names[-1]]


def repeated_slots(base_slots):
    slots = []
    for rep in (1, 2, 3):
        for source in base_slots:
            slot = deepcopy(source)
            slot["source_id"] = source["id"]
            slot["id"] = f"XM01-R{rep}-" + source["id"]
            slot["replicate"] = rep
            slot["dependencies"] = [f"XM01-R{rep}-" + dep for dep in source["dependencies"]]
            seed_text = "CROSS-MODEL-E1-01/v1|" + slot["id"]
            slot["seed"] = int(sha256(seed_text.encode()).hexdigest()[:8], 16) % (2 ** 31)
            slots.append(slot)
    validate_slots(slots)
    return slots


def validate_slots(slots):
    seen = {}
    for slot in slots:
        require(slot["id"] not in seen, "DUPLICATE_SLOT_ID")
        expected_parents = 0 if slot["stage"] == "MERGE" else 1
        require(len(slot["dependencies"]) == expected_parents, "DEPENDENCY_COUNT")
        for dep in slot["dependencies"]:
            require(dep in seen, "PARENT_NOT_EARLIER")
            parent = seen[dep]
            require(parent["stage"] == "MERGE", "PARENT_STAGE")
            for field in ("group", "condition", "role", "replicate"):
                require(slot[field] == parent[field], "CROSS_BRANCH_PARENT:" + field)
        seen[slot["id"]] = slot


def projected_messages(bundle, slot, payload):
    prompt_key = "PROBE" if slot["stage"] == "PROBE" else "MERGE_" + slot["condition"]
    # No material truth, labels, hypotheses, scores, or prior model answers here.
    return [{"role": "system", "content": bundle["prompts"][prompt_key]},
            {"role": "user", "content": "\n資料JSON:\n" + encoded(payload).decode("utf-8")}]


def run_synthetic_case(bundle, pair, slots, answer_fixture, label):
    states, rows = {}, {}
    for slot in slots:
        material = bundle["materials"][slot["group"]]
        if any(dep not in states for dep in slot["dependencies"]):
            rows[slot["id"]] = {
                "status": "DEPENDENCY_MISSING", "raw": None, "payload": None,
                "score": {"strict": None, "content": None, "parts": {}},
                "gate": "NOT_RUN", "fixture": label,
            }
            continue
        payload = pair.e1_input(material, slot, states)
        require(not pair.validate_input("E1", slot["stage"], payload), "INGRESS_REJECT")
        messages = projected_messages(bundle, slot, payload)
        # This is an explicit synthetic fixture, NOT a stand-in used after model errors.
        raw = answer_fixture(material, slot, deepcopy(payload), pair)
        evaluation = pair.e1_evaluate(material, slot, raw, payload)
        row = {
            "fixture": label, "status": "SYNTHETIC", "payload": payload, "messages": messages,
            "raw": raw.decode("utf-8"), "raw_sha256": sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
            "score": evaluation["score"], "gate": evaluation["gate"],
            "bindings": evaluation.get("bindings", []),
            "normalized": evaluation.get("normalized"),
        }
        if slot["stage"] == "MERGE" and evaluation["gate"] == "PASS":
            states[slot["id"]] = deepcopy(evaluation["normalized"]["memory"])
            row["saved_state_sha256"] = sha256(encoded(states[slot["id"]])).hexdigest()
        rows[slot["id"]] = row
    require(set(rows) == {s["id"] for s in slots}, "EXPECTED_ID_SET_MISMATCH")
    return rows


def counts(values):
    values = list(values)
    return {"success": values.count(True), "failure": values.count(False),
            "unresolved": values.count(None), "total": len(values)}


def summarize(pair, slots, rows):
    require(set(rows) == {s["id"] for s in slots}, "SUMMARY_ID_SET_MISMATCH")
    groups = sorted({s["group"] for s in slots})
    reps = sorted({s["replicate"] for s in slots})
    require(reps == [1, 2, 3] and len(groups) == 64, "SUMMARY_DESIGN_COUNT")
    indexed = {}
    for slot in slots:
        key = (slot["group"], slot["condition"], slot["replicate"])
        indexed.setdefault(key, []).append(slot["id"])
    require(len(indexed) == 384 and all(len(ids) == 4 for ids in indexed.values()), "GROUP_REP_COUNT")
    result = {
        "kind": "SYNTHETIC_OFFLINE_ONLY", "model_generations": 0,
        "material_count": 64, "replicates_per_material": 3, "planned_responses": len(slots),
        "independent_material_count_not_192": 64,
        "response_status": dict(Counter(row["status"] for row in rows.values())),
        "metrics": {}, "stage_parts": {},
    }
    for metric in ("strict", "content"):
        grouped = {key: pair.rc.tri_and(rows[sid]["score"].get(metric) for sid in ids)
                   for key, ids in indexed.items()}
        methods = {}
        for method in ("REWRITE", "SELECT"):
            values = [grouped[g, method, rep] for g in groups for rep in reps]
            c = counts(values)
            patterns = Counter()
            disagreement = evaluable_pairs = unresolved_pairs = 0
            by_group = {}
            for g in groups:
                v = [grouped[g, method, rep] for rep in reps]
                by_group[g] = v
                pattern = ("has_unresolved" if None in v else "all_success" if all(v)
                           else "all_failure" if not any(v) else "mixed_success_failure")
                patterns[pattern] += 1
                for left, right in combinations(v, 2):
                    if left is None or right is None:
                        unresolved_pairs += 1
                    else:
                        evaluable_pairs += 1
                        disagreement += int(left != right)
            methods[method] = {
                "group_replicate_counts": c,
                "success_bounds": [c["success"] / 192, (c["success"] + c["unresolved"]) / 192],
                "by_replicate": {str(rep): counts(grouped[g, method, rep] for g in groups) for rep in reps},
                "by_group": by_group, "repeat_patterns": dict(patterns),
                "repeat_disagreement": {"different": disagreement, "evaluable_pairs": evaluable_pairs,
                                        "unresolved_pairs": unresolved_pairs,
                                        "rate": disagreement / evaluable_pairs if evaluable_pairs else None},
            }
        s_lo, s_hi = methods["SELECT"]["success_bounds"]
        r_lo, r_hi = methods["REWRITE"]["success_bounds"]
        result["metrics"][metric] = {
            "methods": methods,
            "select_minus_rewrite_missingness_bounds": [s_lo - r_hi, s_hi - r_lo],
            "paired_by_replicate": {
                str(rep): dict(Counter(f"R={grouped[g, 'REWRITE', rep]}|S={grouped[g, 'SELECT', rep]}"
                                       for g in groups)) for rep in reps},
            "p_value": None, "confidence_interval": None,
            "reason": "Descriptive fixed-material replication; no independent-N=192 test.",
        }
    # These are response/component counts, not independent sample counts.
    component_values = {}
    for slot in slots:
        expected_parts = (("private_note.customer", "private_note.coverage", "shared_note.coverage.A", "shared_note.coverage.B")
                          if slot["stage"] == "MERGE" else ("mascot", "channel"))
        for part in expected_parts:
            scores = rows[slot["id"]]["score"].get("parts", {}).get(part, {})
            for metric in ("strict", "content"):
                key = "|".join((slot["condition"], slot["stage"], part, metric))
                component_values.setdefault(key, []).append(scores.get(metric))
    result["stage_parts"] = {key: counts(values) for key, values in sorted(component_values.items())}
    return result


def perfect_fixture(material, slot, payload, pair):
    return encoded(pair.e1_ideal(material, slot))


def expect_rejection(action, reason):
    try:
        action()
    except ValueError as error:
        require(reason in str(error), "WRONG_REJECTION:" + str(error))
        return
    raise ValueError("MISSING_REJECTION:" + reason)


def offline_suite(bundle, pair, slots, verbose=True):
    checks = []
    if verbose:
        print("[1/4] 合成正答で1,536応答の経路を点検（LLM実測ではありません）")
    perfect = run_synthetic_case(bundle, pair, slots, perfect_fixture, "PERFECT_SYNTHETIC")
    summary = summarize(pair, slots, perfect)
    for metric in ("strict", "content"):
        for method in ("REWRITE", "SELECT"):
            require(summary["metrics"][metric]["methods"][method]["group_replicate_counts"] ==
                    {"success": 192, "failure": 0, "unresolved": 0, "total": 192}, "PERFECT_FAILED")
    checks.append("1536_synthetic_paths_and_384_group_replicates")

    target = next(s for s in slots if s["stage"] == "MERGE" and s["condition"] == "REWRITE")
    child = next(s for s in slots if s["dependencies"] == [target["id"]])
    branch = [target, child]
    good_origin = bundle["materials"][target["group"]]["baseline_by_role"][target["role"]]["private_note"]["customer"]["origin_id"]
    wrong_origin = good_origin[:-1]

    def corrupt_origin(material, slot, payload, pair):
        answer = pair.e1_ideal(material, slot)
        if slot["stage"] == "MERGE":
            answer["memory"]["private_note"]["customer"]["origin_id"] = wrong_origin
        else:
            # Explicit synthetic behavior: report the ID found in the actual saved note.
            answer["origin_ids"]["mascot"] = [payload["records"][0]["body"]["customer"]["origin_id"]]
        return encoded(answer)

    if verbose:
        print("[2/4] 誤出典の保持と、正答・出典評価の分離を点検")
    corrupted = run_synthetic_case(bundle, pair, branch, corrupt_origin, "CORRUPT_ORIGIN_SYNTHETIC")
    for sid in (target["id"], child["id"]):
        require(corrupted[sid]["gate"] == "PASS", "SEMANTIC_ERROR_SHOULD_PASS_STRUCTURE")
        require(corrupted[sid]["score"]["strict"] is False and corrupted[sid]["score"]["content"] is True,
                "CONTENT_PROVENANCE_NOT_SEPARATED")
    require(corrupted[child["id"]]["payload"]["records"][0]["body"]["customer"]["origin_id"] == wrong_origin,
            "WRONG_ORIGIN_WAS_REPAIRED")
    checks.append("bad_origin_passes_structure_fails_strict_and_reaches_probe")

    select = next(s for s in slots if s["stage"] == "MERGE" and s["condition"] == "SELECT")
    def stale_selection(material, slot, payload, pair):
        answer = pair.e1_ideal(material, slot)
        role = slot["role"]
        answer["memory"]["shared_note"]["coverage"][role] = {"record_id": "PARTNER_GROUP", "observer": role}
        answer["read_receipt"]["shared_coverage_refs"][role] = ["PARTNER_GROUP"]
        return encoded(answer)
    stale = run_synthetic_case(bundle, pair, [select], stale_selection, "STALE_SELECTION_SYNTHETIC")
    item = stale[select["id"]]
    require(item["gate"] == "PASS" and item["score"]["strict"] is False, "STALE_SELECTION_SCORE")
    selected_input = next(r for r in item["payload"]["records"] if r["record_id"] == "PARTNER_GROUP")
    require(item["normalized"]["memory"]["shared_note"]["coverage"][select["role"]] ==
            selected_input["body"]["coverage"][select["role"]], "COPY_NOT_FAITHFUL")
    checks.append("faithful_copy_of_wrong_selection_is_not_success")

    if verbose:
        print("[3/4] JSON欠損と依存欠測、欠測上下限を点検")
    def bad_json(material, slot, payload, pair):
        raw = perfect_fixture(material, slot, payload, pair)
        return raw[:-1] if slot["id"] == target["id"] else raw
    broken = run_synthetic_case(bundle, pair, slots, bad_json, "BROKEN_JSON_SYNTHETIC")
    require(broken[child["id"]]["status"] == "DEPENDENCY_MISSING", "MISSING_PARENT_WAS_FILLED")
    require(sum(r["status"] == "DEPENDENCY_MISSING" for r in broken.values()) == 1, "WRONG_MISSING_SCOPE")
    broken_summary = summarize(pair, slots, broken)
    bounds = broken_summary["metrics"]["strict"]["select_minus_rewrite_missingness_bounds"]
    require(abs(bounds[0]) < 1e-12 and abs(bounds[1] - 1 / 192) < 1e-12, "MISSING_BOUND_CALCULATION")
    checks.append("malformed_json_blocks_only_its_own_probe_without_imputation")
    checks.append("missingness_bounds_use_64_materials_times_3_repeats")

    # A single changed replicate must register as two discordant repeat pairs.
    altered = deepcopy(perfect)
    altered[target["id"]]["score"]["strict"] = False
    changed = summarize(pair, slots, altered)
    repeat_stats = changed["metrics"]["strict"]["methods"]["REWRITE"]["repeat_disagreement"]
    require(repeat_stats == {"different": 2, "evaluable_pairs": 192, "unresolved_pairs": 0, "rate": 2 / 192},
            "REPEAT_DISAGREEMENT_CALCULATION")
    checks.append("within_material_repeat_disagreement_2_of_192_pairs")

    if verbose:
        print("[4/4] ID集合・反復間の混線・同梱コードの改変検知を点検")
    expect_rejection(lambda: validate_slots(slots + [slots[0]]), "DUPLICATE_SLOT_ID")
    crossed = deepcopy(slots)
    victim = next(s for s in crossed if s["replicate"] == 2 and s["stage"] == "PROBE")
    victim["dependencies"][0] = victim["dependencies"][0].replace("XM01-R2-", "XM01-R1-")
    expect_rejection(lambda: validate_slots(crossed), "CROSS_BRANCH_PARENT:replicate")
    incomplete = dict(perfect)
    incomplete.pop(target["id"])
    expect_rejection(lambda: summarize(pair, slots, incomplete), "SUMMARY_ID_SET_MISMATCH")
    checks.extend(["duplicate_id_rejected", "cross_replicate_parent_rejected", "missing_result_id_rejected"])
    examples = {"corrupt_origin": corrupted, "stale_selection": stale,
                "broken_json": {sid: broken[sid] for sid in (target["id"], child["id"])}}
    return {"status": "PASS_OFFLINE_SYNTHETIC_ONLY", "checks": checks,
            "perfect_fixture": summary, "missing_fixture": broken_summary,
            "changed_repeat_fixture": changed, "examples": examples}


def run_offline_cell(blob, expected_digest, output_dir=None, verbose=True):
    bundle = unpack_bundle(blob, expected_digest)
    pair = load_fixed_code(bundle)
    slots = repeated_slots(bundle["base_slots"])
    # A new folder per invocation keeps the demonstrations separate and avoids overwrite.
    if output_dir is None:
        parent = Path("/content") if Path("/content").is_dir() else Path(tempfile.gettempdir())
    else:
        parent = Path(output_dir).expanduser()
        parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    out = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="npp-xm01-offline-", dir=str(parent)))
    if verbose:
        print("CROSS-MODEL-E1-01 / オフライン実装点検のみ / モデル生成 0")
        print("GPU・ネットワーク・認証・Drive接続は使用しません。")
    report = offline_suite(bundle, pair, slots, verbose=verbose)
    # Hash failure checks use a deliberately wrong digest / altered source.
    expect_rejection(lambda: unpack_bundle(blob, "0" * 64), "BUNDLE_HASH_MISMATCH")
    changed_bundle = deepcopy(bundle)
    source_name = next(iter(changed_bundle["sources"]))
    changed_bundle["sources"][source_name] += "\n# changed\n"
    changed_bytes = encoded(changed_bundle)
    expect_rejection(lambda: unpack_bundle(base64.b64encode(zlib.compress(changed_bytes)).decode(),
                                          sha256(changed_bytes).hexdigest()), "SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH")
    report["checks"].extend(["bundle_digest_mismatch_rejected", "source_digest_mismatch_rejected"])
    (out / "code").mkdir()
    for name, source in bundle["sources"].items():
        (out / "code" / name).write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
    (out / "bundle.json").write_bytes(encoded(bundle) + b"\n")
    (out / "allocation.json").write_bytes(encoded(slots) + b"\n")
    (out / "offline-report.json").write_bytes(encoded(report) + b"\n")
    file_hashes = {str(p.relative_to(out)): sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                   for p in sorted(out.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}
    (out / "MANIFEST.json").write_bytes(encoded({"kind": "SYNTHETIC_OFFLINE_ONLY", "model_generations": 0,
                                                "bundle_sha256": expected_digest, "files_sha256": file_hashes}) + b"\n")
    if verbose:
        print(f"完了：{len(report['checks'])}項目。合成1,536応答、LLM性能の測定は0件。")
        print("出力先:", out)
        print("このファイルは実機推論・中断再開を未実装です。実機版は接続準備で別途固定します。")
    return out

"""One-cell supervisor; setup helpers retained from the tested XM01 Colab runner."""
import base64

from hashlib import sha256

import importlib.util

import json

import os

from pathlib import Path

import platform

import re

import shutil

import signal

import subprocess

import sys

import time

import traceback

import uuid

import zipfile

import zlib

def colab_available():
    if platform.system() != "Linux" or not Path("/content").is_dir():
        return False
    try:
        return importlib.util.find_spec("google.colab") is not None
    except (ImportError, ModuleNotFoundError):
        return False

def require_colab():
    if not colab_available():
        raise RuntimeError("Colab専用です。このマシンではモデル取得・ロードを行いません。ColabのGPUランタイムへ貼ってください。")

def atomic_new(path, raw):
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("上書き拒否: " + str(path))
    temporary = path.with_name(path.name + ".tmp-" + uuid.uuid4().hex)
    with temporary.open("xb") as f:
        f.write(raw)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.rename(temporary, path)
    if path.read_bytes() != raw:
        raise RuntimeError("保存後の読返しが不一致")

def jbytes(value):
    return (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n").encode()

def put_or_match(path, raw):
    if path.exists():
        if path.read_bytes() != raw:
            raise RuntimeError("保存済みのコード・材料・設定が異なります。旧実行へ混ぜません: " + path.name)
    else:
        atomic_new(path, raw)

def run_child(command, log_path, env, deadline):
    remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
    if remaining <= 0:
        raise TimeoutError("今回の実行時間上限に達しました。")
    with log_path.open("ab", buffering=0) as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, env=env, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            # Mirror the log without collecting unbounded output in notebook memory.
            with log_path.open("rb") as reader:
                while child.poll() is None:
                    chunk = reader.read(32768)
                    if chunk:
                        print(chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), end="", flush=True)
                    if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
                        raise TimeoutError("今回の実行時間上限。子プロセスを停止します。")
                    time.sleep(0.5)
                chunk = reader.read()
                if chunk:
                    print(chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"), end="", flush=True)
            if child.returncode:
                raise RuntimeError(f"子プロセス終了コード {child.returncode}。ログ: {log_path.name}")
        finally:
            if child.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    child.wait(timeout=5)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    child.wait(timeout=5)

def prepare_python_environment(venv, window_dir, env, deadline, torch_version):
    """Manage a pip-less venv from Colab's pip; do not invoke ensurepip."""
    setup_log = window_dir / "setup.log"
    # Reconfigure even when bin/python exists: it can survive a failed creation.
    run_child([sys.executable, "-m", "venv", "--without-pip", "--system-site-packages", str(venv)],
              setup_log, env, deadline)
    python = str(venv / "bin/python")
    check = '''import json,sys,sysconfig
from pathlib import Path
expected=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve(); prefix=Path(sys.prefix).resolve()
assert prefix==expected and sys.prefix!=sys.base_prefix, 'Target is not the requested virtual environment'
assert Path(sysconfig.get_path('purelib')).resolve().is_relative_to(expected), 'Install target is outside venv'
x={'executable':sys.executable,'prefix':sys.prefix,'base_prefix':sys.base_prefix,'purelib':sysconfig.get_path('purelib')}
Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(x,indent=2)); print(json.dumps(x),flush=True)
'''
    run_child([python, "-c", check, str(venv), str(window_dir / "venv-check.json")],
              setup_log, env, deadline)
    pip_check = '''import pip,re
v=tuple(map(int,re.match(r'(\\d+)\\.(\\d+)',pip.__version__).groups()))
print('Host pip:',pip.__version__,flush=True)
assert v>=(22,3), 'Colab host pip must be >=22.3 for --python; no automatic base-environment update'
'''
    run_child([sys.executable, "-c", pip_check], setup_log, env, deadline)
    constraint = window_dir / "torch-constraint.txt"
    atomic_new(constraint, ("torch==" + torch_version + "\n").encode())
    run_child([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "--python", python, "install", "--disable-pip-version-check",
               "--index-url", "https://pypi.org/simple", "--constraint", str(constraint),
               "transformers==5.17.0", "accelerate==1.15.0"], setup_log, env, deadline)
    return python


def load_readout_support(packed, folder):
    names = ('cross_model_e1_01_offline_runtime', 'cross_model_e1_01_generation_runtime',
             'readout_load_01_scoring', 'readout_load_01_runtime')
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name, source in packed['code'].items():
        if not re.fullmatch(r'(cross_model_e1_01|readout_load_01)_[a-z_]+\.py', name):
            raise ValueError('Unexpected embedded source')
        if sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() != packed['contract']['source_hashes'][name]:
            raise ValueError('Embedded source hash mismatch')
        put_or_match(folder / name, source.encode())
    sys.path.insert(0, str(folder))
    try:
        for name in names:
            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, folder / (name + '.py'))
            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
            sys.modules[name] = module

PROTOCOL = 'READOUT-LOAD-01-RUN-v0.1'
DESIGN_SHA = 'd875ffba03fc3f97ef7226df67000b270d009362f5dc76a7123f80c7c08f1d37'
REQUESTS_SHA = 'e2ec43753116a3a1d2838a7971cb67ea7be3c0e9e986115b5436c9cafd948a78'


def validate_payload(packed):
    core.require(sha256(packed['design_text'].encode()).hexdigest() == DESIGN_SHA, 'DESIGN_CHANGED')
    core.require(sha256(packed['requests_text'].encode()).hexdigest() == REQUESTS_SHA, 'REQUESTS_CHANGED')

    core.require([s['id'] for s in design['allocation']] == [q['id'] for q in requests], 'REQUEST_ORDER')
    for name, src in packed['code'].items():
        core.require(sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest() == packed['contract']['source_hashes'][name], 'CODE_HASH')
    for name, src in packed['bundle']['sources'].items():
        core.require(sha256(src.encode()).hexdigest() == packed['bundle']['source_hashes'][name], 'LEGACY_CODE_HASH')
    core.require(packed['contract'] == contract_for(packed), 'CONTRACT_CHANGED')
    core.require(design['model'] == {'model': live.MODEL_ID, 'revision': live.MODEL_REVISION,
        'pins': live.PINS, 'generation': live.GENERATION, 'max_input_tokens': live.MAX_INPUT_TOKENS,
        'enable_thinking': False, 'dtype': 'bfloat16', 'attention': 'sdpa'}, 'MODEL_SETTINGS_CHANGED')
    return design, requests


def contract_for(packed):

            'bundle_sha256': live.digest(packed['bundle']),
            'source_hashes': {n: sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest() for n, s in packed['code'].items()},
            'max_generations': 96, 'seconds_including_setup': 5400, 'automatic_regenerations': 0,
            'resume_generation': False, 'checkpoint_every': 24, 'cloud_drive': 'not_used',
            'retention': 'private_no_deletion_deadline', 'delivery': 'zip_download',
            'eos_policy': 'Remove one final im_end only, retaining raw token IDs; no text repair.'}


def initialize(root, packed):
    validate_payload(packed)
    root = Path(root)
    root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

                      ('requests.json', packed['requests_text'].encode())]:

def preflight(packed):
    """Synthetic transport/scoring check only; never writes research responses."""
    design, requests = validate_payload(packed)
    pair = core.load_fixed_code(packed['bundle'])
    cases = {c['id']: c for c in design['cases']}
    for slot, request in zip(design['allocation'], requests):
        case = cases[slot['case']]
        core.require(not pair.validate_input('E1', 'PROBE', case['payload']), 'INPUT_SCHEMA')
        core.require(request['messages'][1]['content'] == '\n資料JSON:\n' + scoring.enc(case['payload']).decode(), 'MESSAGE_PAYLOAD')
        core.require(request['messages'][0]['content'] == design['prompts'][slot['condition']], 'MESSAGE_PROMPT')

        core.require(value['channel'] and value['format_valid'], 'SYNTHETIC_SCORE')

def verify_root(root, packed):
    design, requests = validate_payload(packed)
    root = Path(root)
    core.require((root / 'design.json').read_bytes() == packed['design_text'].encode(), 'SAVED_DESIGN_CHANGED')
    core.require((root / 'requests.json').read_bytes() == packed['requests_text'].encode(), 'SAVED_REQUESTS_CHANGED')
    core.require(live.read_json(root / 'contract.json') == packed['contract'], 'SAVED_CONTRACT_CHANGED')
    core.require(live.read_json(root / 'bundle.json') == packed['bundle'], 'SAVED_BUNDLE_CHANGED')
    for name, src in packed['code'].items():
        core.require((root / 'code' / name).read_bytes() == src.encode(), 'SAVED_CODE_CHANGED')
    for module in (core, live, scoring, sys.modules[__name__]):
        p = Path(module.__file__)
        core.require(sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == packed['contract']['source_hashes'][p.name], 'ACTIVE_CODE_CHANGED')

def response_score(folder, case, slot, design, pair):
    response = live.read_json(folder / 'response.json')
    core.require(response['payload_sha256'] == live.digest({k: v for k, v in response.items() if k != 'payload_sha256'}), 'RESPONSE_HASH')
    core.require(response['seed'] == slot['seed'], 'RESPONSE_SEED')
    core.require(response['finish_reason'] in ('EOS', 'LENGTH', 'TIME_LIMIT'), 'FINISH_REASON')
    ids = response['output_token_ids']
    core.require(type(ids) is list and all(type(x) is int for x in ids) and len(ids) <= 2048, 'OUTPUT_TOKENS')
    eos = bool(ids and ids[-1] == live.SPECIAL_TOKEN_IDS['<|im_end|>'])
    core.require((response['finish_reason'] == 'EOS') == eos, 'EOS_INCONSISTENT')
    return scoring.score(response['answer_text'], case, slot['condition'],
                         design['schemas'][slot['condition']], pair, response['finish_reason'])


def complete_response(store, pair, design, case, slot):
    folder = store.directory(slot)
    value = live.read_json(folder / 'response.json')
    score = response_score(folder, case, slot, design, pair)
    for name, raw in [('answer.txt', value['answer_text'].encode()),
                      ('decoded-with-special-tokens.txt', value['decoded_with_special_tokens'].encode())]:
        if (folder / name).exists():
            core.require((folder / name).read_bytes() == raw, 'ANSWER_CHANGED')
        else:
            live.write_new(folder / name, raw)
    status = value['finish_reason']
    if status == 'EOS' and not score['format_valid']:
        status = 'FORMAT_REJECT'
    return store.finish(slot, status, score, 'COMPONENT_SCORING')


def run_routes(root, packed, backend=None, deadline=float('inf'), close_pending=False, checkpoint=None):
    design, requests = verify_root(root, packed)
    pair = core.load_fixed_code(packed['bundle'])
    cases = {c['id']: c for c in design['cases']}
    store = live.EvidenceStore(root, packed['contract'])
    rows = {}
    for slot, request in zip(design['allocation'], requests):
        folder = store.directory(slot); case = cases[slot['case']]
        unknown = scoring.score(None, case, slot['condition'], design['schemas'][slot['condition']], pair)
        if (folder / 'input.json').exists():
            saved = live.read_json(folder / 'input.json')
            core.require(all(saved[k] == request[k] for k in request), 'INPUT_CHANGED')
        if (folder / 'started.json').exists():

            core.require(marker['input_sha256'] == sha256((folder / 'input.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'START_INPUT_HASH')

                core.require(score == result['score'], 'SCORE_REPLAY_MISMATCH')
                core.require((folder / 'answer.txt').read_bytes() == value['answer_text'].encode(), 'ANSWER_MISMATCH')
                expected_status = 'FORMAT_REJECT' if value['finish_reason'] == 'EOS' and not score['format_valid'] else value['finish_reason']
